rotation: Local bone rotations relative to the rest pose as unit quaternions [x, y, z, w], expressed in the rest-pose world axes (+x body's left, +y up, +z front); Q_bone = Q_parent * q_local, applied about the bone head. Missing bones = identity. Values differ per body variant (neutral/female/male).
root: Translation [x, y, z] in metres added to the root bone (and so to the whole body) per variant; seated poses lower the pelvis so the body rests on y = 0.
handMirror: hand.*.rot holds LEFT-hand bones (*.L); apply the mirrored quaternion [x, -y, -z, w] to the matching *.R bone. hand.*.arms (if present) overrides arm bones of both sides explicitly.
compose: local = body.rot[variant]; if hand.arms: local.update(hand.arms[variant]); local.update(fingers of hand.rot[variant] for both sides; with the open hand body.openRot[variant] replaces hand.rot when present: the lotus dhyana fingers); root = body.root[variant].
